_readme: Consumption audit trail for UT-N (2026-09-08). Every template with a local consumer repo under C:\dev must list EVERY Type="Variable" Target it declares, each with a one-line citation of where the consuming repo actually reads and USES it (not just declares it). tests/test_variable_consumption.py enforces that the two lists (template vs. this file) match exactly, and that a template flagged no_local_consumer carries no per-var entries. This file does NOT re-derive consumption on its own (this repo's CI has no checkout of the private consumer repos) — it is the durable record of the audit a human/worker performed, so a Variable added without one is caught structurally instead of silently accreting. Re-measure and update the citation whenever the corresponding line in the consumer repo moves.

vars.FLASK_SECRET_KEY: config.py:82-84 -> Flask SECRET_KEY, session signing; app fails closed (503) if blank
vars.APP_BASE_URL: config.py:158-179 (OAuth redirect URIs); mailer.py:34; request_trust.py:175 (trusted-host check)
vars.FLASK_ENV: config.py:95-96 sets DEBUG flag; main.py:57 branches logging behavior on it

vars.DB_HOST: config.py assembles the owner SQLAlchemy URL from this; app/db.py engine connection
vars.DB_USER: same DB URL assembly (owner login; migrations run as this role)
vars.APP_DB_USER: app/db.py assembles the runtime (non-owner) SQLAlchemy URL gunicorn actually connects as (keystone#14)
vars.APP_DB_PASSWORD: same runtime DB URL assembly; container fails closed at boot if unset while DB_HOST is set
vars.TRUSTED_PROXIES: app/core/throttle.py + app/main.py: which peers' X-Forwarded-For is believed for per-IP rate limiting and audit rows
vars.TAPE_BASE_URL: app/tape_client.py:167-169 -> httpx.AsyncClient base_url; raises TapeClientError if blank
vars.TAPE_API_KEY: app/tape_client.py:173,178-179 -> X-API-Key header (legacy, sent alongside the client-id pair)
vars.JWT_SECRET_KEY: app/core/tokens.py: JWT signing; auth endpoints answer 503 fail-closed if short/blank
vars.FILE_ENCRYPTION_KEY: app/core/kms.py: Fernet key wrapping stored secrets / file vault
vars.ADMIN_MFA_RESET: app/core/breakglass.py: arms the one-shot MFA reset on next boot
vars.ADMIN_RECOVERY_EMAIL: app/core/breakglass.py: the one account ADMIN_MFA_RESET is allowed to touch
vars.ALLOW_UNSAFE_DB_POSTURE: app/main.py boot check: downgrades the RLS-posture refusal to a warning
vars.WEB_CONCURRENCY: docker-entrypoint.sh:117 -> gunicorn --workers "${WEB_CONCURRENCY:-2}"; app/core/throttle.py notes it governs worker count for the shared-state design

vars.SCHWAB_USER: reauth.py:101,945 _fill(SEL_USER, SCHWAB_USER, ...) filled into the login form
vars.SCHWAB_PASS: reauth.py:102,946 _fill(SEL_PASS, SCHWAB_PASS, ...) filled into the password field
vars.TAPE_CLIENT_ID: reauth.py:85 CLIENT_ID -> X-Client-Id header on the TOKEN_URL read
vars.TAPE_CLIENT_SECRET: reauth.py:86 CLIENT_SECRET -> X-Client-Secret header on the TOKEN_URL read
vars.DEPLOY_ENV: alerting.py:404,912 load_alert_settings(...)/validate_boot(...) — the only one of the three ops-alerting env names this module still reads (SHARED_ROOT/CONFIG_PATH are hardcoded module constants); reauth.py:2097 in the boot dump
vars.ALERT_SELFTEST: reauth.py:97; boot_alerting() sends one-shot test notification on SELFTEST == "1"
vars.REAUTH_RETRY_HOURS: reauth.py:282 RETRY_H used for retry sleep bound
vars.SEED_MODE: docker-entrypoint.sh branches on it; reauth.py seed() vs loop()
vars.SEED_VNC_PASSWORD: docker-entrypoint.sh required check, written to VNC pass file, then unset
vars.REAUTH_SEED_HOLD_SECONDS: reauth.py:325 SEED_HOLD_S gates how long the headed browser stays open in seed()

vars.TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY: app/core/tokens.py:134 Fernet key for token-at-rest encryption; also decrypts every encrypted app_config credential row (config_store.py)
vars.DB_HOST: app/config.py sqlalchemy_url property; docker-entrypoint.sh:9-35 boot gate
vars.DATABASE_URL: app/config.py:474 Settings.database_url; sqlalchemy_url property (~537-539) uses it as the override that wins over the discrete DB_* vars when set
vars.DEPLOY_ENV: app/alerting.py:configure_alerting -> kw_common.alerting_env.load_alert_settings; picks the ntfy topic and gates boot (T12 retired the old NTFY_URL Variable this replaces)

vars.DESK_API_TOKEN: app/config.py:165 api_token field; app/main.py:184,199 — the one gate for both GET /api/v1/data and POST /mcp; unset, both routes refuse every request (Increment 4, PR#30/#31, v0.7.0)
vars.DEPLOY_ENV: app/bootlog.py:52 (ALERTING_VARS); read by vendored kw_common.alerting_env to pick the ntfy topic and gate boot (SHARED_ROOT/CONFIG_PATH are baked Dockerfile ENV values as of the-desk PR#27, no longer template Variables — same pattern as reauth-bot's DEPLOY_ENV citation above)
vars.TZ: app/config.py:128 comment + app/rules.py:271 — governs cron's local-timezone behavior at the libc/tzlocal level, not a direct os.environ read in app code
vars.DESK_INTAKE_SETTLE_SECONDS: app/config.py:196; app/intake.py:452,471,476-478 — a candidate file younger than this is left for a later scan pass

keystone-db.note: stock postgres image; POSTGRES_* vars are consumed by the upstream postgres entrypoint, not a repo under C:\dev

tape-db.note: stock timescaledb image; POSTGRES_* vars are consumed by the upstream postgres entrypoint, not a repo under C:\dev

tldw-redis.note: third-party redis image; no consuming repo under C:\dev

tldw-server.note: third-party tldw_server image; no consuming repo under C:\dev

vars.KEYSTONE_API_URL: lib/keystone.ts baseUrl(): every Route Handler upstream fetch; throws if unset; app/api/health/route.ts reachability probe
vars.SESSION_COOKIE_MAX_AGE: lib/session-cookie.ts maxAge(): Max-Age of the httpOnly refresh cookie (default 43200)
